about: Court Side QA checklist: every P-row of the plan's section 0. checks are what qa/run.mjs can run today (kind unit | e2e | qa | tool | pending); manual points at qa/HEADSET.md items. owner is the build stream. Tests and e2e checks name their rows by tagging P<number> in the test or check name.

rows.requirement: Seat on camera F's optical ray at D' from the pair: floor point under the seated head, court yaw = camera yaw, eye at the judge's own seated height.
rows.how: seatmath.test.ts; e2e arrival seat pose log; every seat row also tested at the plan's camera-to-eye offset
rows.threshold: floor point <= 0.10 m from the ray point at D' (default 5 m, ?seat= 4-7 m); yaw error <= 0.5 deg

rows.requirement: The projected footage lands on the 3D court lines and rim at life size; the calibration passes its gate.
rows.how: check_align.py; calibration gate; e2e seat overlay
rows.threshold: court points <= 0.02 deg median, <= 0.05 deg p95; rim 3.05 +/- 0.03 m; A-B triangulation agrees <= 0.05 deg

rows.requirement: Footage edges fall into the rendered court and the dark arena, never a hard video edge; the lit region follows the pan.
rows.how: e2e layers at 6 head yaws (0, +/-60, +/-120, 180 deg) and looking up, through a pan
rows.threshold: brightness step across the frustum edge <= 3 grey levels per pixel

rows.requirement: One video frame per display frame at exact display times.
rows.how: e2e cadence capture: per-display-frame motion, judged as the detrended CV (lib.mjs judderVerdict); held and skipped frames counted
rows.threshold: judder = detrended CV (frame motion / its 9-frame running median) <= 0.15 over pass 1 and 2, raw CV info only; 0 held frames; 0 skipped show frames

checks.reason: no judder measurement source yet (detrended CV over passes 1 and 2); see lib.mjs judderVerdict

rows.note: smooth_metrics.py (named in the plan) doesn't exist; the reference is court-spikes/smooth/py/analyze.py judder_summary plus this detrend

rows.requirement: Decode never shows: two WebCodecs decoders, queue never starved.
rows.how: e2e decode log; Q0/Q1 isConfigSupported and decode timing
rows.threshold: queue 1-4, never empty; decode p99 <= 3 ms on the Quest; no decoder reset or seek at a press

rows.requirement: The ease lands exactly on F on the C2 speed curve, with no step.
rows.how: clock.test.ts; e2e ease
rows.threshold: every press before the cutoff lands on F (0 frames off); speed change <= 0.02 per frame; motion max/median <= 2.5; clock step = round(dt x displayHz)

rows.requirement: In-between frames are honest and clean: no ghost hands or ball, each listed, share shown in the Reality check.
rows.how: contact sheet of every interpolated run by eye (last 0.3 s first); Reality check label
rows.threshold: no ghost hands or ball; each in frames.json; Reality check shows the interpolated share

checks.reason: contact sheet of interpolated runs is by eye on the real bundle

rows.requirement: Same pixels at the dolly seat: the 3D under the video layer is the video layer.
rows.how: handoff_check.py (mono renders at the seat and at camera F); e2e handoff per eye at 2-10 cm sideways and 40 cm up
rows.threshold: <= 0.05 deg p95 mono, <= 0.055 deg per eye; PSNR >= 30 dB players, >= 32 dB elsewhere

rows.requirement: No jump in light, colour or sharpness through the fade; no shimmer in a held frame.
rows.how: e2e capture through the fade; held still frame under head sway
rows.threshold: mid-fade SSIM >= 0.95; <= 1 grey level luma per frame at 72 Hz; player Delta-E <= 2; Laplacian ratio 0.8-1.25

rows.requirement: The video layer fades out over fully drawn, sorted 3D; splat opacity is never faded in.
rows.how: handoff.test.ts on handoff(p); e2e handoff
rows.threshold: splats drawn from 0.45 s before F; fade 1.0 s +/- 1 frame; opacity constant; head rise > 10 cm finishes the fade in 0.3 s

rows.requirement: Sharp players, faces and hands; no floaters.
rows.how: freeze_check.py at 6 ring poses and 1.5 m; floater count; held-out PSNR
rows.threshold: sharpness >= 0.7x the source crop on each body, face and both hands; 0 floaters > 5 cm off the body

rows.requirement: Feet on the floor at real size.
rows.how: foot_check.py; scale from the calibrated court
rows.threshold: every sole in contact within 1.5 cm of y = 0; body scale within 3% of listed heights

rows.requirement: Lit like the arena: contact shadows, soft reflections, one grade.
rows.how: estimate_light.py; e2e
rows.threshold: shadow under every contact foot; court/pool chroma error vs the players' white <= 0.02

rows.requirement: Zero drift while walking.
rows.how: e2e walk (17 poses, our maths only); Q2 tape check at a floor mark
rows.threshold: 0 mm in e2e; <= 1 cm after a 2-minute walk on the Quest

rows.requirement: Full frame rate while walking and leaning in.
rows.how: Q1-Q3 stats.ts frame log + OVR Metrics Tool
rows.threshold: 0 dropped frames in a 60 s walk; GPU p95 <= 85% of 13.9 ms

rows.requirement: Every other player reads as a solid 3D person from every reachable spot.
rows.how: e2e contact sheet at every viewing spot (and the ring poses); by eye
rows.threshold: no card edge-on (relief only < 15 deg); no holes; feet on the floor; a contact shadow

rows.requirement: You never enter a body, and leaning in never fades one.
rows.how: e2e poses in walk
rows.threshold: eye 0.2 m from torso/head: that player fades to 30% within 300 ms; eye 0.3 m from ball or hand: no fade

rows.requirement: The 3D folds back into the footage, then the play runs on through the make.
rows.how: e2e capture; clock.test.ts
rows.threshold: P8 and P9 in reverse; resume 0 -> 0.6x over 0.8 s (<= 0.02 per frame); ball drops through the rim before the window dims

rows.requirement: No commentary, no voices; mix level on target.
rows.how: VAD on the final mix, then Whisper, then one listen
rows.threshold: 0 voiced frames, 0 words; -23 LUFS +/- 1; <= -1 dBTP

checks.reason: VAD + Whisper on the final mix has no tool yet (real bed)

rows.requirement: The time stop: hush as time slows, rush back on play.
rows.how: sound.test.ts (OfflineAudioContext render)
rows.threshold: low-pass and about -14 dB over the 1.2 s ease; rush back over 0.6 s; no clicks

rows.requirement: Palm menu only; no gesture acts by itself.
rows.how: e2e controls
rows.threshold: Step in / Back / Walk closer / Next view / Reality / Replay / See my room work; pinches, grabs, swipes change nothing

rows.requirement: Caption, honesty label and credit are always there.
rows.how: e2e controls text check
rows.threshold: label text exact: Real footage, rebuilt in 3D. Not affiliated with the NBA or the players.; caption names who, which game, the moment

rows.requirement: Reality check marks everything the camera never saw.
rows.how: e2e controls on/off
rows.threshold: unseen splats, unfilmed court, floor/stands, inpainted plate, filled holes, extras tinted blue; seen % per player; interpolated share shown

rows.requirement: Nothing moves the world but you.
rows.how: e2e: world transform per phase
rows.threshold: constant, except the walking anchoring and re-seats, each behind a <= 0.3 s fade

rows.requirement: Zero console errors or warnings; ten full runs in a row without a reload.
rows.how: e2e console; Q1-Q3 remote devtools
rows.threshold: 0 console errors or warnings from court code; 10 full runs at Q3

rows.requirement: Starts fast and fits in memory.
rows.how: Q1 cold start and tab memory
rows.threshold: cold start from cache <= 10 s; every asset in memory before the cable comes off; tab memory <= Q0 ceiling minus 30%

rows.requirement: Arrival waits for the judge: black and room tone until the page is visible and the head is seated and still; no menu first.
rows.how: e2e arrival with a simulated visibilitychange and head poses
rows.threshold: black + room tone while hidden; lights-up within 1.1 s of a still seated head after Seat here

rows.requirement: The time stop looks like one light field: crowd and floor dim while the pair stays lit.
rows.how: e2e ease capture; the darker alternative shown at Q2
rows.threshold: crowd 0.45, floor outside the pool 0.30, pair 1.0 (players' pixels change <= 1 grey level)

rows.requirement: The walking layout keeps 1 m clear of each body and the bodies fit the floor.
rows.how: seatmath.test.ts
rows.threshold: chair and ring points >= 1.0 m from both bodies; at 3.5 x 3.5 m both bodies >= 0.3 m inside the play area

rows.requirement: The courtside plate never reads as a poster.
rows.how: e2e contact sheet at every viewing spot, by eye
rows.threshold: plate dims steadily with the angle off the camera ray, dark by ~45 deg; front row, photographers, ref on depth cards

rows.requirement: The crowd is around you: HRTF sources at the stands, none head-locked.
rows.how: sound.test.ts audio graph; e2e arrival; by ear at Q1
rows.threshold: at least 4 HRTF sources at the stands, none head-locked

rows.requirement: Seat here is a 2 s hold button; setup can't be hit by accident.
rows.how: e2e controls
rows.threshold: acts only after 2.0 s; a 1 s press changes nothing

rows.requirement: Arena mode is fully opaque.
rows.how: e2e room alpha read-back
rows.threshold: alpha 255 at every pixel of every frame, except where the edge fade opens the room

rows.requirement: See my room works in all 9 phases.
rows.how: e2e room toggle in all 9 phases, alpha read-back
rows.threshold: fades 0.6 s out and 0.8 s back +/- 1 frame; player matte identical through the toggle; alpha 0 on room pixels, > 0 on players and shadows; extras beyond bounds hidden; Walk closer and Next view hidden

rows.requirement: The room always opens near the edge.
rows.how: e2e with a simulated bounds polygon; Q0/Q1 at a wall; presenter's wall-walk
rows.threshold: starts fading in 0.6 m from the bounds, fully visible at 0.3 m; the Quest boundary still draws in the opaque session

rows.requirement: The court bundle is never public.
rows.how: qa never-public: serve.mjs bind and Host checks, vite does not serve the bundle; tunnel curl at the demo
rows.threshold: bundle not served by vite; serve.mjs answers only on 127.0.0.1

rows.requirement: A reload works with the cable off.
rows.how: Q1: unplug, reload, play
rows.threshold: back to a seated arrival from the Service Worker cache within 45 s

rows.requirement: The hand-over keeps the session through headset off and on.
rows.how: Q0/Q1: headset off, then on
rows.threshold: the session survives visible-blurred; the arrival starts on visible

rows.requirement: No flashes in the baked show.
rows.how: smooth_metrics.py --flash on the baked show
rows.threshold: no single-frame luma spike > 8 grey levels against both neighbours; 0 WCAG 2.3.1 general flashes

rows.requirement: No broadcast branding in the show, plates or our UI.
rows.how: contact sheet of the show and plates; diff inside the watermark box (see private plan)
rows.threshold: watermark gone from every show frame and plate; no NBA or team marks in our UI

checks.reason: no tool for the watermark-box diff yet (stream A, real bundle only)

rows.requirement: Every fallback flag is tested against its own P-rows.
rows.how: qa fallbacks table (each flag loads and passes its rows); recorded on the headset at Q2
rows.threshold: each flag of the plan's risk table loads, passes its own rows, and is recorded at Q2

rows.requirement: The real view really trained the freeze.
rows.how: each freeze run's recon-*.json fields and peek-source image (private run folders)
rows.threshold: focalHeld true; focal = FOCAL; silhouette iou >= 0.95; the peek matches by eye

checks.reason: reads private run folders (recon-*.json); no checker yet

rows.requirement: No doubled or torn bodies in the watch: every person on their own card, the plate has no people.
rows.how: e2e layers on a stand-in with a gap between the pair and a third person
rows.threshold: no doubled or torn body > 0.1 deg in any display frame

rows.requirement: The light moves smoothly and matches through the ease, hand-off, pool and stands.
rows.how: e2e stepped capture from the seat; by eye on the Quest
rows.threshold: MAD <= 1 grey level video vs 3D; every light change <= 1 grey level per frame at 72 Hz; dark gradients dithered

fallbacks.note: the pre-built 90 Hz bake when the 72 Hz lock is refused
pass 1 on a <video> element if WebCodecs fails
D' at the near end of the range
D' at the far end of the range
body model posed to the freeze pose when a player's input has holes
main pair to the next pre-trained splat cap down (needs a value from the bundle: wired when the flag lands)
